[standards/infrastructure/iac/README.md#overview]

## Overview

This directory contains enterprise standards governing all Infrastructure as Code at Gainwell Technologies. These standards cover the complete IaC lifecycle: repository structure, module sourcing, deployment patterns, platform onboarding prerequisites, state management, linting, security scanning, testing, and continuous delivery pipelines.

All product repositories that provision AWS infrastructure using Terraform and Terragrunt **must** comply with the standards in this directory. The standards are designed as an ordered dependency chain — earlier standards define the scaffold and contracts that later standards build on.
page_texts.4:
[standards/infrastructure/iac/README.md#technology-context]

## Technology Context

| Component | Tool | Role |
|-----------|------|------|
| Provisioning language | Terraform | Authors formation modules (`iac/terraform/formations/aws/`) |
| Deployment orchestration | Terragrunt | Manages per-environment deployment configurations (`iac/terraform/deployments/aws/`) |
| Shared module library | `git@github.com:mygainwell/pfe-iac-modules.git` | Sole approved source for all AWS resource modules |
| State backend | AWS S3 + DynamoDB | Remote state and locking; provisioned and managed by Platform Engineering |
| Linting | `terraform fmt` + `tflint` | Code style and rule enforcement |
| Security scanning | Checkov | IaC misconfiguration detection |
| Testing | `terraform test` | Formation unit tests using `mock_provider` |
| CI/CD | GitHub Actions (`cd-deploy.yml`) | Plan-then-apply pipeline with human approval gates for production |
page_texts.5:
[standards/infrastructure/iac/README.md#platform-engineering-pfe-pg-dependency]

## Platform Engineering (pfe-pg) Dependency

Product teams do not provision their own VPCs, subnets, EKS clusters, or state backends. Platform Engineering (pfe-pg) owns all foundational infrastructure. Product IaC consumes platform outputs via `terraform_remote_state`. The prerequisite sequence is:

1. Conceptual and logical architecture approved (ARB)
2. pfe-pg onboarding ticket opened and confirmed
3. Deployment zone active in target environment
4. Product IaC authoring begins

page_texts.6:
[standards/infrastructure/iac/README.md#iac-standards-index]

## IaC Standards Index

| Standard ID | Title | Status | Compliance Level | Description |
|-------------|-------|--------|-----------------|-------------|
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-001](./STD-INFRA-IAC-001-repository-scaffold.md) | IaC Repository Structure Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Defines the required directory layout (`iac/terraform/formations/aws/`, `iac/terraform/deployments/aws/`), `.project.yml` `iac:` block schema, environment short name registry, and `verify.sh` verification utility. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-002](./STD-INFRA-IAC-002-module-sourcing.md) | pfe-iac-modules Mandatory Sourcing Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Establishes `git@github.com:mygainwell/pfe-iac-modules.git` as the sole approved module source, prohibits raw `resource "aws_*"` blocks in product formations, mandates semver tag pinning, and defines the PE escalation path for missing modules. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-003](./STD-INFRA-IAC-003-deployment-pattern.md) | Single-File Deployment Pattern Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Defines the four-file Terragrunt deployment pattern (`terragrunt.hcl`, `common-includes.hcl`, `security-groups.hcl`, `security-group-rules.hcl`), prohibits primary/secondary subdirectory splits, and mandates `TG_REGION_CONTEXT` for region selection. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-004](./STD-INFRA-IAC-004-platform-onboarding.md) | Platform Deployment Zone Prerequisites Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Defines the pfe-pg deployment zone confirmation gate, `product_abr` registration requirements, CIDR allocation through Platform Engineering, EKS cluster registration prerequisites, and the advance onboarding ticket process. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-005](./STD-INFRA-IAC-005-state-management.md) | Terraform State Management Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Mandates S3 + DynamoDB remote state via pfe-pg platform state bucket, requires `acquire-tfstate` as the first CD pipeline step, prohibits hardcoded VPC/subnet values, and governs `terraform_remote_state` data source patterns. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-006](./STD-INFRA-IAC-006-linting.md) | IaC Linting Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Mandates `terraform fmt` as the canonical formatter, requires per-formation `.tflint.hcl` configuration, defines required and suppressible tflint rule sets, and addresses `call_module_type=none` for git-SSH module sources. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-007](./STD-INFRA-IAC-007-security-scanning.md) | IaC Security Scanning Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Establishes Checkov as the mandatory IaC security scanner, defines blocking versus non-blocking finding categories, grants a specific exception for `CKV_TF_1` when using semver-pinned pfe-iac-modules sources, and requires review of all non-blocking findings. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-008](./STD-INFRA-IAC-008-testing.md) | IaC Testing Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Establishes `terraform test` as the mandatory testing mechanism, specifies minimum test cases every formation must implement using `mock_provider`, defines required test file location and naming (`tests/unit.tftest.hcl`), and sets the minimum Terraform version for test support. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-009](./STD-INFRA-IAC-009-ci-verification.md) | IaC CI Verification Pipeline Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Defines `verify.sh` as the single verification source of truth, mandates the six-step CI job sequence (fmt → tflint → validate → test → terragrunt validate → checkov), specifies blocking vs. advisory behavior per step, and governs tool version pinning. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-010](./STD-INFRA-IAC-010-cd-pipeline.md) | CD Pipeline Requirements Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Defines the required GitHub Actions CD pipeline structure (`cd-deploy.yml`), mandates plan-before-apply for all deployments, requires human approval gates between plan and apply for production environments, specifies the `DEPLOYMENT_PATH` contract, and governs Helm-only software rollback. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-011](./STD-INFRA-IAC-011-environment-scaffolding.md) | Environment Scaffolding Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Defines the architecture approval gate before scaffolding, required files per environment, short name convention (dev/test/prf/cfg/sit/uat/prd), environment registry in `.project.yml`, and the acquire-tfstate-first deployment sequence. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-012](./STD-INFRA-IAC-012-resource-tagging.md) | IaC Resource Tagging and Cost Allocation Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Mandates all tags flow through `common.tags` in pfe-iac-modules, defines 7 required tag keys, enforces `ManagedBy: terraform:<deployment_name>` format, and prohibits Checkov tag suppression on HIPAA resources. |
| [STD-INFRA-IAC-013](./STD-INFRA-IAC-013-secrets-handling.md) | IaC Secrets Handling and Credential Management Standard | Draft | Mandatory | Prohibits secrets in IaC files, mandates auto-generated DB credentials via `random_password` + `secrets-manager` module, enforces IRSA for pod Secrets Manager access, defines `{product_name}/{concern}` naming, and requires Gitleaks in CI. |

[standards/infrastructure/iac/README.md#getting-started]

## Getting Started

**Starting a new product repository with IaC?**

1. Read [STD-INFRA-IAC-004](./STD-INFRA-IAC-004-platform-onboarding.md) first — confirm your deployment zone prerequisites before writing a single line of HCL.
2. Scaffold the repository per [STD-INFRA-IAC-001](./STD-INFRA-IAC-001-repository-scaffold.md).
3. Author formations sourcing from pfe-iac-modules per [STD-INFRA-IAC-002](./STD-INFRA-IAC-002-module-sourcing.md).
4. Create deployment directories per [STD-INFRA-IAC-003](./STD-INFRA-IAC-003-deployment-pattern.md).
5. Configure state per [STD-INFRA-IAC-005](./STD-INFRA-IAC-005-state-management.md).
6. Pass all local quality gates ([STD-INFRA-IAC-006](./STD-INFRA-IAC-006-linting.md), [STD-INFRA-IAC-007](./STD-INFRA-IAC-007-security-scanning.md), [STD-INFRA-IAC-008](./STD-INFRA-IAC-008-testing.md)) before raising a PR.
7. Ensure the CI/CD pipeline conforms to [STD-INFRA-IAC-010](./STD-INFRA-IAC-010-cd-pipeline.md).

**Have an existing IaC structure that predates these standards?**

Open a CRB Architecture Exception referencing the specific requirement IDs that conflict with your current structure. All scaffold exceptions carry a maximum 90-day remediation window. Contact the Platform Engineering team to plan the migration.
